Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Card Q&A.a: 1 of your Digimon with [Dracomon] in its text or 1 of your Digimon with [Examon] in its text.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be unsuspended by this card's [All Turns] effect?

Card Q&A.a: It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.
Card Q&A.q: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?

Card Q&A.a: A card with [Dracomon] in its text or a card with [Examon] in its text.
Card Q&A.q: What cards will trigger this card's inherited effect when they would leave the battle area?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving. This card's inherited effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's inherited effect when multiples of my Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle at the same time, are all of those Digimon prevented from leaving?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, 1 of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text may unsuspend.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle, by suspending this Digimon, they don't leave.
